summary: security lens over statement-model (20 product path(s), 3d57c3c..36daf1c, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 1 blocking, 1 non-blocking. blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Require every budget batch to provide its outline snapshot (backend/src/warehouse/ingestion.repository.ts:62): `replaceBudgetBatch` retains the old two-argument contract by making `outline` optional, while the implementation defaults it to `[]`.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Apply the workbook row limit to outline nodes as well as leaves (backend/src/ingest/mis-budget.parser.ts:126): Subtotal rows are appended to `outline` and then skip the only `glRowCount`/expanded-row limit check.
